amihud_measurement_audit.meaning: price movement per unit of spot quote turnover; larger values indicate greater measured illiquidity
amihud_measurement_audit.volume_unit: Binance spot quote volume in USDT accumulated over the 4-hour interval

liquidity_target_semantics.future_amihud_24h_mean: mean of six 4-hour Amihud values at t+1 through t+6; Amihud uses 1e6*absolute 4-hour log return divided by 4-hour Binance spot quote volume in USDT
liquidity_target_semantics.future_corwin_schultz_spread_24h: mean of five two-adjacent-4-hour-bar Corwin-Schultz high-low spread estimates wholly inside t+1 through t+6; nonnegative range-based spread proxy, not a transaction-level quoted spread
liquidity_target_semantics.future_kyle_abs_lambda_24h: absolute OLS slope of 288 subsequent 5-minute log returns on signed spot quote order flow (2*taker-buy quote volume - total quote volume), t+1 through t+6; this is a price-impact proxy, not a quoted spread

note: No forecast fit, model selection, correlation-driven selection, or new network request was performed by this audit. External outcome validation is limited to coverage/validity counts; external target distributions and forecast scores were not inspected.

phase5_parity.comparison: rebuilt Phase-7 BTC/ETH 4-hour rows vs frozen Stage-3/Phase-5 Phase-5 dataset
